newsitem.title: USA: New England power pool starts new tariff March 1.
newsitem.headline: New England power pool starts new tariff March 1.

text.p: The New England Power Pool (NEPOOL) on March 1 implemented its new tariff designed to open the region's wholesale electricity market to all customers, a NEPOOL spokesman said.
Late Friday, NEPOOL received approval from the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to begin providing information to the OASIS (Open Access Same-Time Information System).
"There will be the same (transmission) rate across the board, including utilities, brokers and marketers," the NEPOOL spokesman said.
OASIS, launched on Jan 3, is an Internet-based system providing real-time information on prices and available transmission capacity on U.S. high-voltage lines.

The newly-implemented tariff, which was submitted to FERC for review in late December, is part of the pool's effort to conform to open-access guidelines as the electricity industry moves toward deregulation.

NEPOOL has about 140 members, including Northeast Utilities, Boston Edison Co, and New England Electric System. More than 90 percent of the pool voted in favor of the tariff prior to its filing with FERC.
